documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto reported record-breaking annual financial and operational performance for FY26, with consolidated revenues crossing INR63,000 crores and PAT exceeding INR10,000 crores. Management highlighted broad-based growth across domestic motorcycles, commercial vehicles, and exports, alongside a significant scaling of their electric vehicle portfolio which achieved double-digit EBITDA margins for the year. For the upcoming periods, the company noted potential demand softening and sharp commodity cost inflation, which they intend to counter through strategic price hikes, cost optimization, and favorable currency tailwinds. Additionally, the Board approved a 100% payout of last year's profits via a final dividend and a tender-route buyback. Bajaj Auto Limited reported its highest-ever quarterly revenues and profitability for Q3 FY26, driven by record volumes across domestic motorcycles, commercial vehicles, electric vehicles, and exports, supported by GST rate cuts and currency tailwinds.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects the Export business to deliver its highest-ever top-line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment has softened in April due to general inflation, vehicle price increases, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The motorcycle category growth is expected to slow down from 20% in Q4 to 7% to 9% in the near term.
demand_outlook.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects motorcycle growth to come almost entirely from the 125cc plus segment and particularly the 150cc plus segment.
demand_outlook.quote: But having said that, the great thing from our point of view is that we expect this growth to come almost entirely from the 125cc plus segment and even more so from the 150cc plus segment, which should grow at twice the industry rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness continued or increased growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Latam demand has remained very healthy, driving rapid export growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Now we don't know how that will play out, but demand has remained very healthy, particularly in Latam.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the ICE segment for three-wheelers grew by 4% to 5% following GST cuts.
demand_outlook.quote: The ICE segment was declining in April-August period by about 4%, but GST cuts have bumped up growth to positive 4% to 5%.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded production capacities at Bajaj Brazil to support sales.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

capex_expansion.claim: The footprint of Riki is being expanded to 50 cities in North and East India.
capex_expansion.quote: Steadily, the footprint of Riki is being expanded to now 50 cities in North and East India.

margins_costs.claim: Quarter 4 EBITDA margins stood at 20.8%, sustained despite challenges in the operating environment.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at INR3,323 crores and the margins at 20.8% sustained despite challenges in the operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: Net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points for Q4 after taking pricing.
margins_costs.quote: And therefore, net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points. This is after taking pricing.

margins_costs.claim: Management estimates a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the upcoming period.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: The company took judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of the material cost inflation impact so far.
margins_costs.quote: Once again, we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded by 30 basis points sequentially to 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

orders_capacity.claim: Brazil manufacturing capacity has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak capacity has reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month. I think we will max that.

orders_capacity.claim: The exports business crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October 25 and surpassed 600,000 units in the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintains a 70%+ market share in the ICE segment with an 85%+ share in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores, a reflection of the very robust cash conversion on profit.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100% of last year's profits, split as a final dividend of INR150 per share and a tender-route buyback at INR12,000 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties in terms of LPG shortage, manpower availability, and outbound logistics impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted cost pressures across the metals complex, with noble metals seeing sharp increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards past service cost arising from new labour code wage definitions.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: New introductions in the Pulsar brand will hit the market as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects buyback payouts to happen sometime in the second week of July.
management_commitments.quote: Looking at the fresh timelines, I would expect that payouts would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.

management_commitments.claim: Over 8 more interventions will be made in the Pulsar portfolio in the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team exercise for KTM Austria will be completed by 1st April.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

management_commitments.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms will be expanded to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: The KTM business will be fully consolidated into results on a line-by-line basis starting from the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: However, from the next quarter onwards, the KTM business will be fully consolidated into our results on a line-by-line basis as is required for subsidiaries.
